workflow.title: Understand the support

name: Signoff360

captions: A further view of the Signoff360 website presentation.
data.relationship: Developed within the Kliqnet product portfolio
data.stageNote: Workforce software supporting evidence management and review. Regulatory decisions remain with the responsible provider and professionals.
data.problem: Care teams need to see workforce records, training and competency evidence in context. The platform brings these workflows together so managers can review what is complete, what needs attention and who can take the next step.
contribution: Audit history and document renewal visibility

workflow.title: Define the journey
workflow.text: Mapped CQC inspection requirements into digital compliance rules

workflow.title: Shape the experience
workflow.text: Designed automated alerting for document expirations and renewals

data.outcome: Connected workflows for reviewing workforce evidence, training and competency records. The product supports the provider’s governance work without claiming to guarantee an inspection outcome.

name: KliqPOS

data.stageNote: Live pilot at ESQ. Payment-reader and printing integrations require configuration for each venue.

workflow.text: A venue workspace connects tables, products and open orders.

name: ROTDULE
tagline: Make the working week easier to run.
shortDescription: Workforce scheduling, time records, leave and payroll preparation in one operational system.

data.coverCaption: ROTDULE public website overview, captured September 2026.
data.relationship: Developed within the Kliqnet product portfolio
data.stageNote: In operational use. This case study describes the workforce system; it does not claim measured time savings or replace payroll advice.
data.problem: Scheduling is connected to attendance, leave and payroll preparation. ROTDULE gives teams one way to manage these records while preserving the history behind changes and approvals.

workflow.title: Plan the week
workflow.text: Build and publish rotas with staff assignments and conflict checks.

workflow.title: Review time
workflow.text: Managers review attendance, breaks and exceptions before approval.

workflow.title: Prepare payroll
workflow.text: Approved records support reconciliation and controlled pay-period snapshots.

data.outcome: An operational workforce platform, with use at ESQ described on the product website. It connects the working week to the records needed for payroll preparation.
data.decision: The product is industry-agnostic. Working hours, roles and policies belong to each organisation’s configuration, so one venue’s way of working does not become everyone’s default.

name: Skeduda

data.relationship: Developed within the Kliqnet product portfolio
data.stageNote: Controlled rollout. Public channel access and messaging capabilities depend on provider approvals and account setup.
data.problem: Social content work spans brand context, assets, drafts, schedules and publishing outcomes. Skeduda connects those records so teams can understand what is planned and what happened next.

workflow.title: Plan with context
workflow.text: Brand information and media sit alongside the content draft.

workflow.title: Prepare publication
workflow.text: Channel and schedule choices are connected to the intended account.

workflow.title: Follow the outcome
workflow.text: Publication status and history help teams identify the next action.

data.outcome: A product foundation connecting content planning, publication records and supported messaging workflows, with controlled provider rollout.
